checksum_scope: SHA256SUMS covers every published file except itself; PUBLISHED_FILES.txt lists all files including itself and SHA256SUMS.
excluded: Original provider responses and JSONL traces
Local private search records and detailed scan-location records
Original Git history and author identities

historical_full_suite.limitation: Benchmark manifests and datasets are omitted; only the 49 delivery regressions were rerun.

privacy_scan.method: Signatures, private keys, JWTs, authenticated URLs, bearer tokens, assignments, known local secrets, personal paths/email and high-entropy literals; synthetic fixtures reviewed.

purpose: Independent root-commit review snapshot for Claude; not production or an integration.

snapshot_checks.network_guard: Socket connect/connect_ex/create_connection blocked; API credential variables removed; Git SSH disabled.
snapshot_checks.scope: Two delivery regression modules executed against the isolated snapshot source.
